name: Dimecoin
note: Populate `electrum_servers` with the host:port of a Dimecoin ElectrumX server the team operates, then submit this coin definition to the AtomicDEX/MM2 coin list and the `electrums/DIME` file in KomodoPlatform/coins (mirroring `electrums/DASH`). Dimecoin reuses Bitcoin's xpub/xprv prefixes (0x0488B21E / 0x0488ADE4), so HD derivation matches Bitcoin.
